summary: Climber fell 70 feet to the ground and was killed when the rope was severed on a sharp edge during a rappel on Yellow Spur.
notes: [Merged 2026-09-10: RMRG 2010 page confirms rope-failure fatality investigation; Yellow Spur rope-failure report linked from page.] [Merged 2026-09-11: RMRG Yellow Spur rope-failure investigation PDF (archived crawl): belayer account says third piece of protection pulled, rope severed mid-fall, leader struck ground near base of route; initial protection had a long sling so no sideways belay force was felt.]
